title: Norm Technology Absolutely Feature Complete
description: Create the norm technology as headless Rust crates for end-to-end norm compliance computation: shared norm_core plus one family crate per listed path (norm/din/v/18599, norm/din/4108, norm/din/en/16798, norm/en/1990-1999), each implementing every part of that family with German national annex where applicable.
summary: Created norm technology with norm_core shared kernel and 13 headless family crates (DIN 4108, DIN EN 16798, DIN V 18599, EN 1990–1999). Each crate exposes part modules with clause-traced CheckResult APIs, German NA where applicable, and e2e unit tests. EN 1992 integrates fem_core via inline beam element for FEM-driven RC checks. Registered all crates in Cargo workspace, nx project.json/script.ts per bundle, and launch.json test target. All 17 norm tests pass.
